clues.text: Lazarus lived in this village with his sisters Mary and Martha when he fell sick.
This village, where Jesus came after Lazarus died, lay a little less than two miles from Jerusalem.
In the home of Simon the Leper in this village, a woman poured expensive perfume on Jesus' head.
After the children shouted Hosanna in the temple, Jesus left the city and spent the night here.
When Jesus left this village the next day, He was hungry and found a fig tree with nothing but leaves.
Jesus led His disciples out as far as this place, blessed them, and was carried up into heaven.
Near this village at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two disciples to bring a colt no one had ridden.
